methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The objective of this paper is to present the design and modeling of the Energy Management System (EnMS) in energy-intensive industries in an enterprise engineering approach, according to the management discipline called Business Process Management (BPM).

stage1.ineligibility_reason: EnMS/BPM process framework without an identifiable or characterised EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The process design created in the “should be” format presents a framework based on the Plan, Do, Check and Act (PDCA) cycle.

stage1.notes: EnPI and energy baselines are named as outputs of the Energy Review, but no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach is characterised.
